propositions: Core reconciler passes its transport/client as unannotated parameters, so mypy cannot enforce that TicketTransport declares every member the core calls.
15 functions in rebar_reconciler take a client/transport parameter with no annotation while 10 already annotate one.
Annotating parameters as Any satisfies the disallow_untyped_defs ratchet while remaining completely blind, so promotion via Any would silently reintroduce the port-completeness defect.
The plan proposes annotating parameters as the TicketTransport port and treating each resulting [attr-defined] error as a finding to be resolved by declaring the missing member on the port.
The ticket's central premise no longer holds: the three-way mypy probe does not reproduce because the custom metaclass on TicketTransport makes mypy stop attribute-checking the annotated type.

The metaclass _TransportPortMeta is load-bearing for J9's uncached runtime isinstance conformance guard, so a design fork is needed between giving mypy a checkable plain Protocol or accepting static blindness and relying on the runtime guard alone.
